question: If I withdraw ten days after classes begin, what share of the tuition I paid is refunded?
answer:
If you withdraw ten days after classes begin, you are eligible for a refund of 75% of the tuition fee you actually paid [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6 Refunds on withdrawal].

This is based on the following policy for withdrawals:

| Withdrawal request received | Tuition refund |
|---|---|
| Within 14 days after classes begin | 75% of tuition paid |

Please note the following conditions regarding your refund:
* Examination and laboratory fees are non-refundable once the term has started [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6 Refunds on withdrawal].
* Refunds are processed to the original payment account within 30 working days [Doc: Fee Payment & Refund Policy 2026-27 §6 Refunds on withdrawal].
